summary: Add personal allowlisted self-hosted interface fonts and compact, readable activity typography with private saved preferences and committed audit keys.

api.reason: Add optional Preferences.fontStyle enum to existing GET/PATCH /me with Standard default and omission preservation; no new endpoint or PAT scope.
api.permissions: Active-member Google JWT and App Check self-service only. PAT/unapproved/cross-account preference writes remain denied.

metrics.reason: Font preference saves add only the fontStyle key to appearance audit metadata, using the existing atomic settings.audit.committed outbox and safe request/exporter signals. Values, previews and comments are excluded; no-op/denied changes do not emit a committed change. Deployment events include this exact version/commit.

manualVerification: Preview-before-save, all four font families at390/768/1280/1920px, Book-mode precedence/restoration, branding/monospace protection, full multi-line/unbroken comments, All/Comments/Calls filtering and15px desktop/16px narrow activity text.
